```{r include=FALSE}
library(piamValidation)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(quitte)
library(piamInterfaces)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  error = TRUE,
  message = params$message,
  warning = params$warning
)
```

## Import and Prepare Data

Usage, with the ScenarioMIP snapshot (`.rds`, preprocessed as `df.submissions` in
`scenario_analysis/commons/setup_data_snapshot.R`) and a REMIND historical.mif (H12 regions,
REMIND variable names):

```r
validationReport(
  dataPath = c("scenarios_scenariomip_2026-08-10.rds", "historical.mif"),
  config   = "SCI_2026.8.3",
  report   = "SCI_scenarioMIP")
```

Loading data from:

```{r}
for (m in params$mif) cat(paste0(normalizePath(m), "\n"))
```

Using config:

```{r}
cat(params$cfg, "\n")
```

Thresholds based on:
https://scenario-evaluation-criteria.iamconsortium.org/2026.08.03/

The scenario selection, the marker definition and the conversion of the historical data follow
`scenario_analysis/10_VLMarkerPaper_ValidationPlots.Rmd` and
`scenario_analysis/commons/setup_data_benchmarks.R` of the scenariomip repository.

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE}
# Settings ####

# REMIND-MAgPIE scenarios shown, from high to very low emissions, as in
# 10_VLMarkerPaper_ValidationPlots.Rmd; VL-SSP1 is the marker
selected.RM.scenarios <- c("H-SSP3", "M-SSP2", "ML-SSP2", "L-SSP2", "LN-SSP2",
                           "VL-SSP1")

# SCI criteria not related to the energy system
excludeVars <- c("Food Availability [per capita]")

# SCI evaluates cumulated geological carbon storage (2020-2100), which the
# snapshot does not report; it is calculated from annual storage below
storVar <- "Carbon Capture|Geological Storage"
cumVar  <- "Carbon Capture|Geological Storage|Cumulative"

# Historical sources as in commons/setup_data_benchmarks.R, plus the sources
# for electricity capacities and carbon storage that SCI evaluates
# (GlobalEnergyMonitor is left out: its capacities are not comparable, e.g.
# about 1000 GW solar in 2025 compared to about 2400 GW from IRENA)
historicalSources <- c("BP", "CEDS", "CMIP7_CEDS", "EDGARghg", "IEA",
                       "IEA-EB-directSum", "UNFCCC", "WDI",
                       "Ember", "IRENA", "IEA CCUS")

# Input files: .rds = ScenarioMIP snapshot, .mif = REMIND historical.mif
snapPath <- params$mif[grepl("\\.rds$", params$mif)]
histPath <- params$mif[grepl("\\.mif$", params$mif)]
if (length(snapPath) != 1) stop("Provide exactly one ScenarioMIP snapshot (.rds) in 'mif'.")
if (length(histPath) > 1)  stop("Provide at most one historical.mif in 'mif'.")

# SCI config without the excluded criteria
cfg <- piamValidation:::getConfig(params$cfg) %>%
  filter(!variable %in% excludeVars)
sciVars <- unique(cfg$variable)

# SCI reference data shipped with the package (models such as
# IEA-ESDB-20250610 and CEDS-2025), needed for the historical vetting
sciVersion <- sub("^.*SCI_", "", sub("\\.(csv|xlsx)$", "", basename(params$cfg)))
refPath <- system.file(
  paste0("extdata/SCI_reference_data_", sciVersion, ".rds"),
  package = "piamValidation")
if (refPath == "") stop("SCI reference data not found for version ", sciVersion)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE}
# Scenario data ####
snap <- readRDS(snapPath)
rmData <- snap %>%
  filter(model == "REMIND-MAgPIE",
         scenario %in% selected.RM.scenarios,
         region == "World",
         variable %in% c(sciVars, storVar)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
rm(snap)
invisible(gc())

missingScen <- setdiff(selected.RM.scenarios, unique(rmData$scenario))
if (length(missingScen) > 0) {
  warning("Scenarios not found in snapshot: ", paste(missingScen, collapse = ", "))
}

# marker as flagged in the snapshot (`marker == TRUE`)
markerScen <- unique(rmData$scenario[rmData$marker %in% TRUE])

# cumulated geological storage 2020-2100 (trapezoidal integration, 0 in 2020)
if (!cumVar %in% rmData$variable) {
  cumData <- rmData %>%
    filter(variable == storVar, period >= 2020, period <= 2100) %>%
    group_by(model, scenario, region) %>%
    arrange(period, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(
      step = (period - lag(period)) * (value + lag(value)) / 2,
      value = cumsum(ifelse(is.na(step), 0, step)),
      variable = cumVar,
      unit = "Mt CO2") %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(-step)
  rmData <- bind_rows(rmData, cumData)
}

qCols <- c("model", "scenario", "region", "variable", "unit", "period", "value")
scenData <- select(rmData, all_of(qCols))
scenMeta <- distinct(rmData, scenario, marker, emi.scen)
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE}
# Historical data, converted to the ScenarioMIP template ####
# identical to commons/setup_data_benchmarks.R, but World only
if (length(histPath) == 1) {
  hist <- read.quitte(histPath, check.duplicates = FALSE) %>%
    filter(model %in% historicalSources, period >= 1990, region == "World")

  # default ScenarioMIP mapping, overwritten by the historical-specific mapping
  histDefault <- convertHistoricalData(mif = hist, project = "ScenarioMIP") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
  histManual <- convertHistoricalData(mif = hist, project = "ScenarioMIP_historical") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character))
  histDefault <- filter(histDefault, !variable %in% histManual$variable)

  # keep CMIP7_CEDS as used for emissions harmonization
  histCMIP7 <- hist %>%
    filter(model == "CMIP7_CEDS", period <= 2023, variable != "Emi|CO2|w/o AFOLU") %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
    mutate(variable = sub("^Emi\\|CMIP7\\|", "Emissions|", variable),
           variable = sub("^Emi\\|", "Emissions|", variable))
  histDefault <- filter(histDefault, !variable %in% histCMIP7$variable)
  histManual  <- filter(histManual,  !variable %in% histCMIP7$variable)

  histData <- bind_rows(histDefault, histManual, histCMIP7) %>%
    filter(variable %in% sciVars, !is.na(value)) %>%
    select(all_of(qCols))
  rm(hist, histDefault, histManual, histCMIP7)
} else {
  histData <- tibble(model = character(), scenario = character(),
                     region = character(), variable = character(),
                     unit = character(), period = integer(), value = numeric())
}

refData <- readRDS(refPath) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.factor), as.character)) %>%
  select(all_of(qCols))
```

```{r, message = FALSE, warning = TRUE}
# Validation ####
df <- validateScenarios(
  as.quitte(bind_rows(scenData, refData)),
  cfg,
  extraColors = params$extraColors)
```

Scenarios: `r paste(selected.RM.scenarios, collapse = ", ")`
(marker: `r paste(markerScen, collapse = ", ")`).

Historical data: `r if (length(histPath) == 1) paste(sort(unique(histData$model)), collapse = ", ") else "none"`.

## Line Plots

One plot per variable, containing all SCI criteria of that variable. Historical vetting
(2010-2025) and near-term feasibility (2030-2040) are shown on one time axis from 2005 to 2050,
sustainability criteria up to 2100.

Threshold bands as drawn by `linePlotThresholds()`: green = within thresholds, yellow = above
threshold with medium concern, cyan = below threshold with medium concern. Outside the coloured
bands the concern is high or the historical vetting fails. A band reaching the edge of the plot has
no limit in that direction (e.g. total wind capacity has lower limits only). Plots with values of
10000 or more are shown in the next bigger unit (Gt instead of Mt, TW instead of GW).

The marker scenario is drawn as a solid line, all other scenarios as dashed lines. Points show the
SCI reference data (filled circles) and the sources of the historical.mif. The vertical line marks
2025.

```{r}
# Plot settings ####

# scenario colours by emission level ("gmd" scheme in commons/setup_config.R)
emiColors <- c(H = "#a41212", HL = "#E744F6", M = "#fc7b03", ML = "#dec820",
               L = "#20A359", LN = "#22e5db", VL = "#16188F")
scenOrder <- c(markerScen, setdiff(rev(selected.RM.scenarios), markerScen))
scenOrder <- scenOrder[scenOrder %in% scenMeta$scenario]
scenColors <- setNames(
  emiColors[as.character(scenMeta$emi.scen)], scenMeta$scenario)[scenOrder]
scenLinetypes <- setNames(
  ifelse(scenOrder %in% markerScen, "solid", "dashed"), scenOrder)
scenLinewidths <- setNames(
  ifelse(scenOrder %in% markerScen, 1, 0.6), scenOrder)

# symbols of historical sources; sources sharing a symbol never report the
# same SCI variable
refLabel <- "SCI reference data"
histShapes <- c(4, 3, 2, 5, 0, 1, 6)
histShapeMap <- c(
  "IEA" = 4, "IEA-EB-directSum" = 3, "BP" = 2,
  "CEDS" = 4, "CMIP7_CEDS" = 3, "EDGARghg" = 2,
  "Ember" = 4, "IRENA" = 3,
  "IEA CCUS" = 4, "UNFCCC" = 0, "WDI" = 1)

categoryNames <- c(yes = "Historical Vetting", feasibility = "Feasibility",
                   sustainability = "Sustainability")
categoryText <- c(
  yes = paste("Deviation from the SCI reference data in 2010, 2015, 2020 and",
              "2025. Outside the green band the historical vetting fails."),
  feasibility = "Near-term feasibility criteria.",
  sustainability = paste("General sustainability concerns. Cumulated geological",
                         "storage is integrated from the annual storage,",
                         "starting at 0 in 2020."))

# linePlotThresholds() draws a band only where both of its limits exist.
# Complete the thresholds: a missing high-concern limit is open (Inf above;
# 0 below for absolute checks of non-negative variables, else -Inf), a missing
# medium-concern limit equals the high-concern limit (the SCI historical
# vetting has high-concern limits only). The open lower limit 0 avoids bands
# running below 0 where linePlotThresholds() connects the check years.
completeThresholds <- function(v) {
  nonNegative <- all(v$value >= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
  v %>%
    mutate(
      lowOpen = ifelse(nonNegative & metric == "absolute", 0, -Inf),
      min_red = ifelse(is.na(min_red) | is.infinite(min_red), lowOpen, min_red),
      max_red = ifelse(is.na(max_red),  Inf, max_red),
      min_yel = ifelse(is.na(min_yel) | is.infinite(min_yel), min_red, min_yel),
      max_yel = ifelse(is.na(max_yel) | is.infinite(max_yel), max_red, max_yel))
}

# time axis: historical and near-term criteria up to 2050, long-term
# sustainability criteria up to 2100
plotRange <- function(categories) {
  c(2005, if ("sustainability" %in% categories) 2100 else 2050)
}

# plots with values of 10000 or more use the next bigger unit
unitUp <- c("Mt CO2/yr" = "Gt CO2/yr", "Mt CO2" = "Gt CO2", "GW" = "TW")
largeValue <- 1e4

# convert validation data (values, reference values, absolute thresholds),
# scenario data and historical data by `factor` to unit `newUnit`
convertUnit <- function(v, s, h, factor, newUnit) {
  v <- v %>%
    mutate(value = value * factor,
           ref_value_min = ref_value_min * factor,
           ref_value_max = ref_value_max * factor,
           across(c(min_red, min_yel, max_yel, max_red),
                  ~ ifelse(metric == "relative", .x, .x * factor)),
           unit = newUnit)
  list(v = v,
       s = mutate(s, value = value * factor, unit = newUnit),
       h = mutate(h, value = value * factor, unit = newUnit))
}

plotSCI <- function(var) {
  v <- filter(df, variable == var, region == "World")
  if (nrow(v) == 0) return(NULL)
  xlim <- plotRange(unique(as.character(v$critical)))

  s <- filter(scenData, variable == var,
              period >= xlim[1], period <= xlim[2]) %>%
    mutate(scenario = factor(scenario, levels = scenOrder))
  h <- bind_rows(
    filter(refData, variable == var) %>% mutate(source = refLabel),
    filter(histData, variable == var) %>% mutate(source = model)) %>%
    filter(period >= xlim[1], period <= xlim[2])

  # next bigger unit if values or absolute thresholds are large
  varUnit <- as.character(unique(v$unit))[1]
  absThr <- unlist(v[v$metric == "absolute",
                     c("min_red", "min_yel", "max_yel", "max_red")])
  yValues <- c(s$value, h$value, absThr)
  yValues <- yValues[is.finite(yValues)]
  if (varUnit %in% names(unitUp) && length(yValues) > 0 &&
        max(abs(yValues)) >= largeValue) {
    conv <- convertUnit(v, s, h, 1e-3, unitUp[[varUnit]])
    v <- conv$v
    s <- conv$s
    h <- conv$h
  }

  # threshold bands, axis labels and title from piamValidation
  p <- linePlotThresholds(completeThresholds(v), xlim = xlim,
                          interactive = FALSE)

  histSources <- c(intersect(refLabel, h$source),
                   sort(setdiff(unique(h$source), refLabel)))
  shapes <- c(setNames(16, refLabel), histShapeMap)[histSources]
  unknown <- is.na(shapes)
  shapes[unknown] <- setdiff(histShapes, shapes)[seq_len(sum(unknown))]
  names(shapes) <- histSources
  sizes <- setNames(ifelse(histSources == refLabel, 2.2, 1.6), histSources)

  p <- p +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 2025, colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_line(data = s,
              aes(x = period, y = value, colour = scenario,
                  linetype = scenario, linewidth = scenario)) +
    scale_colour_manual("REMIND-MAgPIE scenarios", values = scenColors,
                        breaks = scenOrder, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linetype_manual("REMIND-MAgPIE scenarios", values = scenLinetypes,
                          breaks = scenOrder, drop = FALSE) +
    scale_linewidth_manual("REMIND-MAgPIE scenarios", values = scenLinewidths,
                           breaks = scenOrder, drop = FALSE)
  if (nrow(h) > 0) {
    p <- p +
      geom_point(data = h,
                 aes(x = period, y = value, shape = source, size = source),
                 colour = "grey15") +
      scale_shape_manual("Historical data", values = shapes,
                         breaks = histSources) +
      scale_size_manual("Historical data", values = sizes,
                        breaks = histSources)
  }
  p +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
          legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm")) +
    guides(colour = guide_legend(order = 1),
           linetype = guide_legend(order = 1),
           linewidth = guide_legend(order = 1),
           shape = guide_legend(order = 2),
           size = guide_legend(order = 2))
}

# one legend for the threshold bands, with the colours and transparencies
# used in linePlotThresholds()
bandLegend <- tibble(
  label = c("above threshold, medium concern", "within thresholds",
            "below threshold, medium concern"),
  fill  = c("#EFB700", "#008450", "#66ccee"),
  alpha = c(0.20, 0.20, 0.30)) %>%
  mutate(label = factor(label, levels = label))
bandLegendPlot <- ggplot(bandLegend, aes(x = 1, y = label, fill = label)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_manual("SCI threshold bands",
                    values = setNames(scales::alpha(bandLegend$fill,
                                                    bandLegend$alpha),
                                      bandLegend$label)) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
        legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm"))
bandLegendGrob <- ggplotGrob(bandLegendPlot)
bandLegendGrob <- bandLegendGrob$grobs[[
  grep("guide-box", vapply(bandLegendGrob$grobs, function(g) g$name, ""))[1]]]

# folder for the PNG files: next to the HTML file, unless `plotDir` is given
plotDir <- params$plotDir
if (plotDir == "") {
  outDir <- knitr::opts_knit$get("rmarkdown.output_dir")
  if (is.null(outDir)) outDir <- getwd()
  plotDir <- file.path(outDir, paste0("plots_SCI_scenarioMIP_",
                                      format(Sys.time(), "%Y%m%d-%H%M%S")))
}
dir.create(plotDir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
pngName <- function(i, var) {
  sprintf("%02d_%s.png", i, gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", var))
}
```

```{r, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 1.4}
grid::grid.newpage()
grid::grid.draw(bandLegendGrob)
invisible(ggsave(file.path(plotDir, "00_legend_threshold_bands.png"),
                 bandLegendGrob, width = 4, height = 1.4, dpi = 300))
```

Each plot is also saved as PNG without title, together with the legend above
(`00_legend_threshold_bands.png`), in:

```{r}
cat(normalizePath(plotDir), "\n")
```

```{r, results = 'asis', fig.width = params$figWidth, fig.height = params$figHeight}
# one plot per variable, in config order, grouped by the SCI categories the
# variable is evaluated in
plotVars <- sciVars[sciVars %in% df$variable]
varCats <- vapply(plotVars, function(x) {
  cats <- unique(as.character(df$critical[df$variable == x]))
  paste(intersect(names(categoryNames), cats), collapse = "+")
}, character(1))

for (sec in unique(varCats)) {
  cats <- strsplit(sec, "+", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
  cat("\n\n### ", paste(categoryNames[cats], collapse = " and "), "\n\n", sep = "")
  cat(paste(categoryText[cats], collapse = " "), "\n\n")
  for (var in plotVars[varCats == sec]) {
    cat("\n\n#### ", var, "\n\n", sep = "")
    p <- plotSCI(var)
    print(p)
    ggsave(file.path(plotDir, pngName(match(var, plotVars), var)),
           p + labs(title = NULL),
           width = params$figWidth, height = params$figHeight, dpi = 300)
  }
}

missingVars <- setdiff(sciVars, plotVars)
if (length(missingVars) > 0) {
  cat("\n\nNot reported by the selected scenarios: ",
      paste0("``", missingVars, "``", collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
}
```
